name: ScarletPico top USB-C / outside flange / adjustable M2 carrier
measurements_still_required: Only the flange 20 x 6 x 1 and presence of two holes were measured by the user.
Actual hole pitch must be within 15.5..17 mm; holes assumed on the flange horizontal centre line.
Actual USB metal body, any rear PCB, solder and wire bends must fit the reserved envelope; 10.4 x 12 x 4.4 is a design allowance, not a product measurement.
Socket mouth must reach the flange outside face; real cable boot/insertion clearance still requires a fit check.
Existing flange holes must pass the chosen M2 fasteners without damaging PCB traces; their diameter is not known.
